messages:
rachel (pr): Quick heads-up: Fortune asked for a 1-line exec quote and embargo time. They said they might run a short preview if we give the quote early.

omar (content): Our publish is 08:00 PT tomorrow. No early runs.

kevin (product): Fine to give a holding line as long as it's non-specific and embargoed. No numbers.

sylvie (legal): I can approve a 1-line neutral quote + 1-sentence method blurb. Need to avoid absolute claims.

omar (content): Draft quote: "These benchmarks reflect recent improvements to inference latency and per-token cost across deployment patterns we commonly see."

rachel (pr): Methods blurb: "We measured end-to-end latency across regions with consistent routing; cost estimates use tokenized workloads and batch-aware execution patterns to mirror customer settings."

sylvie (legal): Tweak: change "customer settings" -> "settings commonly used by our customers". Approving otherwise.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email queued to reporter with embargo language (ID: 2026-03-29-FORT-22).

social-ops: Holding all drafts until blog URL is final.

rachel (pr): Sending now. Request confirmation they will hold to embargo and not publish raw tables early.

press-bot: :white_check_mark: Reporter acknowledged and will hold to embargo.

omar (content): Saving approved copy here for PR/legal record. Closing unless we hear back.
